ei.subject: 공통영어1 미래엔(김성연)
ei.title: Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation

fullPassage: The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry ①<u>analyzes</u> them to produce opposite sound waves. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the ②<u>brightness</u>. However, it is not easy to entirely ③<u>eliminate</u> external noise with this technology. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is ④<u>effective</u> for ⑤<u>predictable</u> sounds like those of car engines and subways.

questions.passage: Sound is produced through (A) that occur from a sound source, when the strings of a guitar are played, for instance. There are two types of interference: (B) and (C). (B) interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a louder sound. (C) interference occurs when a peak overlaps with a valley, producing a quieter sound.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소리는 진동(vibrations)을 통해 생성되고, 간섭에는 보강(constructive)과 상쇄(destructive) 두 종류가 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① vibrations — constructive — destructive: 원문과 일치
❌ ② destructive/constructive 순서 바뀜
❌ ③ frequencies: vibrations가 원문
❌ ④⑤ reflective: 언급 없음
det.tip: vibrations(진동), constructive(보강) ↔ destructive(상쇄)

questions.passage: Microphones are installed in ticket offices to (A) external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer’s voice clearly. They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication between employees and customers by (B) vehicle noise. These noise-cancelling headsets help drive-through employees take orders (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 마이크가 소음을 감지(detect)하고, 차량 소음을 제거(eliminate)하여, 직원이 주문을 정확히(accurately) 받는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① detect — eliminate — accurately: 원문과 일치
❌ ② amplify: eliminate의 반의어
❌ ③ create: detect와 다름, roughly: accurately의 반의어
❌ ④ roughly: 부정확
❌ ⑤ create+amplify: 둘 다 부적절
det.tip: detect(감지) ↔ create(생성), eliminate(제거) ↔ amplify(증폭), accurately(정확히) ↔ roughly(대충)

questions.passage: Fortunately, scientists have ①<u>invented</u> noise-cancelling technology, which is now being used across various fields to ②<u>reduce</u> unwanted noise. Sound is produced through ③<u>vibrations</u> that occur from a sound source. The vibrations of the sound source cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves, similar to the ④<u>shadows</u> created in a lake when you throw a stone. When these sound waves reach our ears, the brain ⑤<u>interprets</u> them as sound.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 "ripples created in a lake"(호수의 잔물결). ④ shadows(그림자)는 ripples와 무관.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ shadows(그림자): 원문 ripples(잔물결) → 호수에 돌을 던지면 생기는 것 = 잔물결
✅ ① invented: 원문 일치
✅ ② reduce: 원문 일치
✅ ③ vibrations: 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ interprets: 원문 일치
det.tip: ripples(잔물결) ↔ shadows(그림자) — 돌을 던지면 호수에 생기는 것 = 잔물결

questions.passage: The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry ①<u>analyzes</u> them to produce opposite sound waves. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the ②<u>brightness</u>. However, it is not easy to entirely ③<u>eliminate</u> external noise with this technology. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is ④<u>effective</u> for ⑤<u>predictable</u> sounds like those of car engines and subways.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 "without turning up the volume"(볼륨을 키우지 않고). ② brightness(밝기)는 volume과 무관.
det.analysis:
❌ ② brightness(밝기): 원문 volume(음량) → 음악 소리와 관련
✅ ① analyzes: 원문 일치
✅ ③ eliminate: 원문 일치
✅ ④ effective: 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ predictable: 원문 일치
det.tip: volume(음량) ↔ brightness(밝기) — 음악 듣기 맥락 = volume

questions.passage: Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and <u>distracting</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 distracting의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: distracting = 주의를 산만하게 하는, annoying = 짜증나는/성가신 → 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ③ annoying: distracting의 유사어
❌ ① pleasant: 반의어
❌ ② attractive: 매력적 → 반대
❌ ④ calming: 진정시키는 → 반대
det.tip: distracting = annoying = bothersome = 산만하게 하는/성가신

questions.passage: They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication by <u>eliminating</u> vehicle noise.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 eliminating의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: eliminating = 제거하는, removing = 제거하는 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② remove: eliminating의 동의어
❌ ① ignore: 무시 → 제거와 다름
❌ ③ increase: 증가 → 반의어
❌ ④ produce: 생산 → 반의어
det.tip: eliminate = remove = get rid of = 제거하다

questions.passage: However, it’s relatively less effective for <u>inconsistent</u> sounds such as those of people talking close to you.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 inconsistent의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: inconsistent = 일관성 없는, irregular = 불규칙적인 → 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ④ irregular: inconsistent의 유사어
❌ ① regular: 반의어
❌ ② consistent: 반의어
❌ ③ foreseeable: 예측 가능한 → 반대
det.tip: inconsistent = irregular = unpredictable ↔ consistent = regular = predictable

questions.passage: This noise-cancellation technology is <u>effective</u> for predictable sounds.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 effective의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: effective = 효과적인 ↔ ineffective = 효과 없는
det.analysis:
❌ ④ ineffective: effective의 반의어
✅ ① harmful: 다른 차원
✅ ② useless: 유사한 부정이지만 nuance 다름
✅ ③ practical: 유사어
det.tip: effective ↔ ineffective: 효과적 ↔ 비효과적

questions.passage: They cancel each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all. This is called <u>destructive</u> interference. The opposite, where waves combine, is <u>constructive</u> interference, where peaks overlap to create a <u>louder</u> sound.
questions.stem: 본문에서 상쇄 간섭의 결과(quieter sound)와 의미가 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: quieter(더 조용한) ↔ amplify(증폭하다) = 소리를 키우다
det.analysis:
❌ ③ amplify(증폭): quieter의 반대 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① decrease(줄이다): quieter와 유사
✅ ② lower(낮추다): 유사
✅ ④ muffle(소리를 죽이다): 유사
det.tip: quieter = decrease = lower = muffle ↔ amplify = louder

questions.passage: Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소음은 불쾌하고 주의를 산만하게(distracting) 하기 때문에 참기 싫어한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ distracting: unpleasant와 병렬 → 부정적 의미
❌ ① pleasant: unpleasant의 반의어
❌ ② useful: 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ interesting: 부정적 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: unpleasant and ___: 부정적 형용사 병렬

questions.passage: Destructive interference occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they __________ each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마루와 골이 겹쳐 서로 상쇄(cancel)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② cancel: cancel each other out = 서로 상쇄
❌ ① amplify: 증폭 → 반대
❌ ③ create: 생성 → 무관
❌ ④ record: 녹음 → 무관
det.tip: cancel each other out = 서로 상쇄하다

questions.passage: As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to __________ among residents.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이웃의 소음이 주민들 간의 갈등(conflict)으로 이어질 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① conflict: 소음 → 주민 간 갈등
❌ ② harmony: 조화 → 반대
❌ ③ cooperation: 협력 → 반대
❌ ④ friendship: 우정 → 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: lead to conflict = 갈등으로 이어지다 — 소음 문제의 부정적 결과

questions.passage: The microphones <u>pick up</u> sounds from the outside.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 pick up의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: pick up sounds = 소리를 수집하다/감지하다
det.analysis:
✅ ② (소리를) 수집하다: 마이크가 소리를 감지
❌ ① (공을) 집어 올리다: 물리적 동작
❌ ③ (속도를) 높이다: pick up speed
❌ ④ (사람을) 태우다: pick someone up
det.tip: pick up: 줍다 | 감지하다(소리/신호) | 속도 올리다 | 태우다(차)

questions.passage: Noise-cancellation technology can help <u>address</u> these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 address의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: address problems = 문제를 다루다/해결하다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 문제를 다루다: address + 문제 = 해결하다
❌ ① 주소: a home address
❌ ② 수신인: address a letter
❌ ④ 연설하다: address an audience
det.tip: address: 주소 | 연설하다 | (문제를) 다루다/해결하다

questions.passage: The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry ①<u>analyzes</u> them to produce opposite sound waves. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the ②<u>brightness</u>. However, it is not easy to entirely ③<u>eliminate</u> external noise with this technology. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is ④<u>effective</u> for ⑤<u>predictable</u> sounds like those of car engines and subways.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"causing a lot of damage or harm; tending to destroy or negate"

det.korean: '많은 피해를 주는; 파괴하거나 부정하는 경향이 있는' → destructive(파괴적인)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ destructive: 영영 정의와 일치
❌ ① constructive: 건설적 → 반의어
❌ ② productive: 생산적
❌ ④ instructive: 교육적
det.tip: destructive = causing damage/harm = 파괴적인 ↔ constructive(건설적인)

questions.passage: The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry ①<u>analyzes</u> them to produce opposite sound waves. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the ②<u>brightness</u>. However, it is not easy to entirely ③<u>eliminate</u> external noise with this technology. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is ④<u>effective</u> for ⑤<u>predictable</u> sounds like those of car engines and subways.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"the process by which two or more waves combine and affect each other"

det.korean: '둘 이상의 파동이 결합하여 서로에게 영향을 미치는 과정' → interference(간섭)
det.analysis:
✅ ② interference: 영영 정의와 일치
❌ ① frequency: 주파수
❌ ③ resonance: 공명
❌ ④ amplitude: 진폭
det.tip: interference = waves combining and affecting each other = 간섭

questions.passage: Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be __________ (pleasant) and distracting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: pleasant(형용사) → unpleasant(형용사): 소음은 "불쾌한" → un- 접두사 추가. distracting과 병렬로 부정적 의미 필요
det.analysis:
pleasant(기분 좋은) → unpleasant(불쾌한)
문맥: 소음은 불쾌하고 산만하게 함 → 부정 의미 필요
det.tip: un- + pleasant = unpleasant(불쾌한) — 접두사 un-은 반대 의미

questions.passage: Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for __________ (predict) sounds like those of car engines and subways that occur regularly or over a period of time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: predict(동사) → predictable(형용사): 명사 sounds를 수식하는 형용사 필요. "예측 가능한 소리"
det.analysis:
predict(동사) → predictable(형용사)
빈칸 뒤 sounds(명사)를 수식하는 형용사 필요
det.tip: predict → predictable / rely → reliable / notice → noticeable — 동사 → -able 형용사화

questions.passage: There are two types of interference: constructive and __________. Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound. __________ interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 보강 간섭의 반대 = 상쇄(Destructive) 간섭. "on the other hand"가 대비 표지.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ Destructive: "on the other hand" → constructive의 반대
❌ ① constructive: 이미 앞에 나옴
❌ ② reflective: 반사적 → 무관
❌ ④ productive: 생산적
❌ ⑤ protective: 보호적
det.tip: constructive ↔ destructive: 보강 ↔ 상쇄 — "on the other hand" = 반대

questions.passage: As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more __________ and healthier lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소음 제거로 사람들이 더 평화로운(peaceful) 삶을 살 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② peaceful: "reducing disturbances" → 방해 감소 = 평화로운 삶
❌ ① disturbed: 방해받는 → 반대
❌ ③ noisy: 시끄러운 → 반대
❌ ④ competitive: 경쟁적 → 무관
❌ ⑤ isolated: 고립된 → 무관
det.tip: reducing disturbances → peaceful: 방해 감소 = 평화
